data.text: DOU policy (dou.ua/forum-articles-howto, read 2026-10-01) contradicts three DOC-35 plans: no links to a product/app in the text; 'we do not promote others' surveys' — the O5 research-recruiting post and the article's interview ask; no AI-generated text (AI may edit, not write). Also: since 2026-03-01 drafts go through the submission form, not an editor's email, so the 'already pitched to editors' path is gone. The site's English post on the same numbers tests DOU's uniqueness rule (author's blog is the exception). Draft without links and without the ask: docs/product/dou-article-2026-10-draft.md.
